summary: Iteration 15 review testing. CRITICAL BLOCKER found in POST /api/auth/register — it returns 500 for every new signup because it inserts NULL into users.timezone but Supabase now has a NOT NULL constraint on that column. Because signup is the entry point of the whole reviewed journey (signup → login → OTP dev_code → onboarding step 0/1/2/3 → dashboard), the child/onboarding UI portion cannot be exercised end-to-end in this environment. Verified separately that the admin path works: admin@ayana.care/AyanaAdmin123! logs in 200, GET /api/admin/stats returns 200 with delivery_funnel {sent,delivered,read,failed}=0, and an authed GET /api/dashboard/bootstrap on the admin account returns 200 with delivery_funnel present as well. GET /api/config = 200. Previous iteration's user ravi.e1test2@ayanabott.com/Test@12345 no longer exists in this DB (login → 401), so we could not reuse an existing non-admin account either. Full pytest run: 2 passed (config, admin stats+funnel), 5 errors chained on the register 500, 2 failed (activate route 404, logout while unauth).

critical.issue: 500 InternalServerError for ALL new signups. asyncpg NotNullViolationError: null value in column "timezone" of relation "users" violates not-null constraint. server.py register() ~L567 inserts city=null, timezone=null explicitly but the current users table has NOT NULL on timezone. Either (a) set a default in the INSERT (e.g. coalesce($9,'UTC') or hard-code 'UTC'/'Asia/Kolkata'), (b) accept optional timezone on RegisterInput and pass it, or (c) drop NOT NULL / add DEFAULT 'UTC' on users.timezone in Supabase. Blocks signup, OTP send (requires auth), onboarding step 0/1/2/3, and dashboard for new users.

rca_of_the_issue: REPRO: POST /api/auth/register with {name,email,phone,password} (any valid unique values) → 500. Backend log (var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log): `asyncpg.exceptions.NotNullViolationError: null value in column "timezone" of relation "users" violates not-null constraint. Failing row contains (..., null, null, null, ...)`. CAUSE: server.py register() explicitly binds `city=null, timezone=null` in the INSERT (line ~L570-577), but the Supabase users table (migration 003 applied on this env) now enforces NOT NULL on `timezone`. Register never had a path to populate it — RegisterInput (models.py L17-31) doesn't even accept timezone. MITIGATION (1-line): change the INSERT to `... values ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::uuid,$6,$7,null,'UTC', now(), null)` OR add `timezone` to RegisterInput and pass Intl-detected value from the frontend signup form. Longer term: `alter table users alter column timezone drop not null;` (or set default) so that fresh code + old schema and vice-versa both work.
